question: Who was the Chief Election Commissioner of India as on 1 April 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sushil Chandra**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sushil Chandra:-**

 
 
• He is an Indian Revenue Service officer from the 1980 batch.
 
• He served as India's **24th Chief Election Commissioner**.
 
• Prior to this, he presided over the **Central Board of Direct Taxes**.
 
• He served as the **Delhi-based International Taxation's Commissioner of Income Tax** (Appeals).
 
• He served as** Gujarat's Director General of Investigation** as well as **Mumbai's Director of Investigation**.
 
• He was appointed the** Election Commissioner of India** on February 15, 2019, and on April 13, 2021, he became the **Chief Election Commissioner of India**.
 
• He has participated in **16 elections**, five of which he has presided over as chief election commissioner.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **India's electoral commission:-**

 
 
• **It **is an independent constitutional body in charge of holding elections at the federal, state, and local levels.
 
• In **article 324 of the constitution**, the Indian Election Commission's authority is outlined. 1950 saw the creation of the Election Commission.
 
• 
 
The secretariat of the commission, which has its** headquarters in New Delhi**, is composed of the Election Commissioners, Deputy Election Commissioners (often IAS officers), Directors General, Principal Secretaries, Secretaries, and Under Secretaries.
